voice: Deep, slow, courteous; Karachi Urdu with Sindhi turns; speaks of his obligations before his orders

metahuman.note: MetaHuman Creator 5.8 body: use the Parametric Body tool, set the constraint targets listed below (cm; the tool shows the real constraint list for the model, use the ones it offers), then blend presets only to taste. Face: blend 2-3 South Asian presets then Sculpt/Move to the notes. Hair/beard from the Groom library.
metahuman.face_notes: Round heavy face, hooded eyes, white eyebrows, full cheeks, a stern gentleness

skin.description: Medium-brown, mottled; darkened shins; tired eyes
skin.note: U/V are starting values for the Creator skin-tone picker; judge by eye under neutral light and adjust

fallback_mannequin.note: Applied automatically by UBodyStateComponent when the mesh has no morph targets

outfits.summer: White cotton shalwar kameez; white crocheted prayer cap (topi); sandals; trouser hems above the ankle
outfits.monsoon: The same; a dark waistcoat; rubber sandals
outfits.winter: Cream shalwar kameez; woollen waistcoat; shawl; wool cap over the topi
outfits.by_act: A4=the same wardrobe; Friday: a spotless white suit and an attar fragrance; Eid: new clothes

accessories: Prayer beads (tasbih); a glucometer and an insulin pen in a leather pouch; a walking stick with a silver head; thick-rimmed glasses; a worn Quran in a velvet cover (never used as a prop)
tells: Counts his tasbih beads when he decides; says 'Insha'Allah' in two different tones: one honest, one a refusal
gait_notes: Slow, rolling waddle with the weight on the heels; breath short on stairs; sits down in stages; the stick leans forward; pauses to check blood sugar
sensitivity: A devout man and a gang boss; faith is shown as sincere and distinct from the crime; attire follows correct practice; no religious site hosts combat.
